The research report

State of AI Data Labs and Human Feedback

12 chapters. Source-level evidence. Clear limits.

This comprehensive prelaunch synthesis covers the selected approved corpus of 65 qualifying suppliers, 152 distinct reviewed paper works, 63 dataset families and 21 benchmark families. Twelve chapters connect documented offerings and delivery roles, technical methods, human operations, commercial scope, rights and security with ten practical paid-pilot designs and acceptance criteria. The eligible inventory remains a lower bound under active boundary review, the core is unfrozen, and the formal reference and screening launch audits are incomplete. No published edition, DOI, human peer review, supplier ranking, complete market inventory or market forecast is claimed.
